skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK [Direct DMG] to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 800% ATK [Direct DMG] to the target area, then hits all enemies with 150% ATK [Ice DMG]. Lowers [Energy Shield Rate] of all enemies by 30% and raises it for all allies by 30%. Inflicts [Corrosion] on the main target, dealing 300% ATK DoT.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 800% > 1100% ATK [Direct DMG] to the target area, then hits all enemies with 150% > 200% ATK [Ice DMG]. Lowers [Energy Shield Rate] of all enemies by 30% > 50% and raises it for all allies by 30% > 50%. Inflicts [Corrosion] on the main target, dealing 300% > 400% ATK DoT.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by 20%. Gains 60% [Non-Crit DMG Free]. Reduces [Chain Explosion] DMG received by 60%.[Non-Crit DMG Free]: effective for all DMG types; cannot co-exist with [Agility].

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: When battle begins, all allies gain a [Toughness] effect equal to 100% of their own Max HP. After any character takes action, 4 random enemy characters receive [True DMG] equal to 100% of the original Locked total DMG. ———- [Toughness]: Absorbs 100% of own health in damage. [True Damage]: Not affected by damage increase or damage reduction, it is damage directly inflicted on the target's HP that cannot be shared or avoided.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: When battle begins, all allies obtain [Resilience] equal to 100% (150%) of their own Max HP and a 100% chance to inflict [Locked On] equal to 100% ATK. After any character acts, inflicts the total [Locked On] as 100% (150%) [True DMG] to 4 random enemies (the entire enemy team at the upgraded rank).[Resilience]: absorbs DMG equal to 100% (150%) HP.[True DMG]: not affected by DMG Rate or DMG Free; deals direct DMG unaffected by [DMG Sharing] or [Instant DMG Evasion].

effects.desc: The shield absorbs damage equal to 100% of the wearer's Maximum Health.
This type of bonus damage is dealt on top of attacks, is reduced by Evasion-type effects, and can be immune after a certain number of turns.
Corrosive damage over time effect, each turn dealing damage equal to a percentage of ST (e.g. 300%) to the target.
